shared_elements: upright slab surface carved in low relief
motifs stacked vertically one above another
curved/arched linear band crossing the surface
justification: The only real correspondence is generic: both surfaces are upright slabs bearing shallow-relief motifs stacked vertically, and both include a circular disc form and a curving band. Otherwise the content is wholly different: A depicts a narrative figural scene of armed men, a mounted rider on a quadruped and a serpent, framed by a plaited border, whereas B shows only abstract, non-figural emblems (a disc within a ring, paired roundels, a crescent-like arc with angular rod), with no human, animal or narrative content at all.
